<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₁₁H₁₄O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O4</final_answer>
